positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
•Coordinate installation, configuration, and evaluation of the data and voice communication network, including Cisco routers, switches, and other network hardware
• Monitor and provide support for the data center, campus network, and network users
• Working knowledge of TCP/IP, WAN, LAN, Routing, Switching, DNS, and DHCP

company.name: Newport News Shipbuilding, A Division of Huntington Ingalls Industries

positions.title: Administrative Assistant - Office of Scheduling
positions.description:
Coordinate basic office operations including answering phones, scheduling events, and assisting scheduling questions from faculty, outside organizations, and student groups.

Requires effective communication, organization, and secretarial skills.

positions.title: Supervisor - Recreational Services
positions.description:
Administered intramural programs and facilitated games throughout the semester

Lead training of intramural officials in order to provide working knowledge of the sports

Certified in CPR and First Aid to be the first responder in the case of injury or accidents

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Served under The Apprentice School to develop and manage student databases, and to design websites for various programs inside The Apprentice School.

Assisted in the Environmental, Health, and Safety department under an industrial hygienist to assimilate sampling data sheets and synthesize information for input into databases for easier access. Assisted with the coordination of a Safety Expo event to showcase safety awareness and accomplishments throughout the company.

company.name: Newport News Shipbuilding, A Division of Huntington Ingalls Industries

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Worked with group of interns that edited media, such as photos, videos, and lectures to preserve, organize, and electronically store information into databases to make them more readily accessible resources.

certifications.name: Microsoft Office 2007: Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
certifications.title: Microsoft Office 2007: Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

volunteerExperiences.description:
Provide services to support various mission projects associated with the church, including home and roof repairs, lawn care, child care, and assistance to the elderly

Volunteered and dedicated two weeks each summer to help the church provide free day camp for families in the area; led and taught children ages 5 to 12
